title: Store Manager Macpac Adelaide Airport
description:
Take the lead at Macpac Adelaide Airport, where no two days look the same!

We're on the hunt for a hands-on Store Manager, or an ambitious Assistant Store Manager ready to step up. Lead a supportive and established team in this busy, high-foot-traffic Harbour Town location.

If you've successfully led teams of 7+, love celebrating wins, put safety first, and thrive on the shop floor, you'll fit right in. Better yet, if you've got outlet or DFO experience, that's a huge bonus!

Adventure starts outside, but your next career adventure starts right here.

  • Sunday to Thursday roster, more time for you.
  • Competitive salary with super, weekly pay, and potential bonus opportunities
  • Fantastic discounts across Macpac, BCF, Supercheap Auto and rebel.
  • True job security, powered by Super Retail Groupâs strength and 750+ stores across Australia and New Zealand.

Whatâs in it for you?

Be rewarded with great work-life balance, group wide career and development opportunities along with:

  • Inclusive & Supportive Culture: Join a diverse, inclusive workplace where you can bring your whole self to work and grow your career.
  • Innovation & Recognition: Thrive in a culture that champions innovation, collaboration, and celebrates your contributions through a dedicated recognition platform.
  • Wellbeing Focus: Benefit from wellbeing initiatives, including 24/7 support through the Sonder app.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy corporate rates on travel, fitness, insurance, entertainment, and more, plus great team discounts through our Perks Program.
  • Parental Support: Access generous Parental Leave from day one, supporting both primary and secondary carers.

Who are we?

Macpac is New Zealand's original outdoor brand and have grown to find a home in the Australian market. We've made it our business to show people that life is better when you're outside. We're a socially conscious business, and we operate in a way that is both ethical and sustainable. As a leader in the outdoor retail space, we have a responsibility to protect and preserve our wild places, and we take that responsibility very seriously. When all is said and done, we are adventurers - and our goal is to facilitate adventure for as many people as we possibly can.

As The Store Manager, You're The Driving Force Behind Maximising Sales, Ensuring Seamless Operations, And Fostering a Positive, Engaging Atmosphere For Your Team. To Thrive Here, You Should Ideally Have

  • Management experience.
  • A track record of leading by example and delivering top-tier customer service.
  • The ability to motivate and inspire your team.
  • Confidence in managing a diverse range of personalities.
  • Strong skills in training, driving floor sales, and achieving results.
  • Experience in visual merchandising, stock control, health and safety, store security, and basic financial reporting.

Having experience with outdoor clothing and equipment is not essential... a passion for the outdoors or travel is preferable.

Who are we looking for?

Macpac Team Members Are

  • Adventure lovers, who are happiest when embracing the great outdoors.
  • Eco-warriors, who walk the talk when it comes to sustainability.
  • Experts, who are passionate about retail and love sharing their knowledge and growing their team.
  • Team players, who understand that a good team is greater than the sum of its parts.

Be our next success story, apply now!

Why Super Retail Group?

We are one of Australasiaâs largest retailers and owner of iconic brands: Supercheap Auto, Macpac, BCF and rebel (AU).

We believe diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are essential to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. We value the unique perspectives and experiences that strengthen our teams and help us innovate, and weâre committed to fostering an environment where everyone feels they belong and can reach their full potential. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process or workplace accommodation to perform at your best, please let us know in your application.

A note to candidates: This is a human-led recruitment process, and every application is reviewed by our Australian Talent Acquisition team. (And yes, this was proudly written by a human too!)

Applications are assessed as they are received and the closing date subject to change. #SuperRetailGroupCareers

Please mention the word **UNDERSTANDABLE** and tag RMTQ1LjEzMi45OS4xMDI= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTQ1LjEzMi45OS4xMDI=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
